title: BlogChangelogEntry
description: blog.changelog-entry@2: one shipped commit as OpenVibe.Blog's network changelog shows it (GET /api/v1/changelog, server/changelog.js). Every entry names what changed in plain words (plain, without its PR number or stage tag) and is tagged with a kind and up to three areas from Blog's fixed list; housekeeping (library pins, merges, test-only and docs-only changes) is kind internal and needs no model. The commit id, its GitHub URL and the pull request that shipped it stay available for the fold under the row.

service.description: The site's registry id (live, chat, blog, …).

repo.description: The GitHub repository the commit shipped from, owner/name.

short.description: The first seven characters of sha.

subject.description: The commit message's first line, as written.

plain.description: The subject in plain words: the PR number and stage tag removed, no other claim added.

kind.description: new: something a person can now do; better: an existing thing improved; fixed: a defect repaired; internal: housekeeping with nothing for a person to notice.

areas.description: One to three of Blog's fixed areas; empty only for kind internal.

deployed_at.description: When the release carrying the commit was seen deployed.

major.description: True when the release was large or named as major; the hints a patch notes post highlights.

post_id.description: The patch notes post that carried it; null while pending and for imported history.

pr.description: The pull request the subject names, when it names one.
